gloss: look of the sky; way things are going

definitions.gloss: look of the sky; movement of clouds
definitions.explanation: The appearance of the sky based on how clouds are moving, especially as an indication of approaching weather.

definitions.gloss: way things are going; signs; outlook; developments
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, the direction a situation is heading, especially when it seems to be turning unfavorable.

examples.japanese: {雲行|くもゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怪|あや}しく→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: The sky is starting to look threatening.

examples.english: Looking at the sky, I decided to bring an umbrella.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is extremely common and often appears with ⟦{怪|あや}しい→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧ (suspicious, ominous). The expression {雲行|くもゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怪|あや}しい→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧ can refer to either literal weather or figurative situations going badly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雲行|くもゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怪|あや}しい→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧ (the sky / situation looks threatening)
- {雲行|くもゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (the sky / situation changes)
- {雲行|くもゆ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch the sky / assess the situation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧: trend, developments — more formal and analytical
- ⟦{形勢|けいせい}→形勢：16342_keisei⟧: situation, state of affairs — often used for competitions or battles
